questions.question: It's the first week of the semester. You'd rather...

choices.c1: Join a group project chat and start throwing out ideas

choices.c2: Read through the syllabus twice before saying anything

questions.question: You just solved a tricky bug in your code. What now?

options.c1: Tell everyone in the group chat immediately

options.c2: Quietly commit it and move on to the next problem

questions.question: Given a messy dataset, your first instinct is to...

choices.c1: Check column types, nulls, and ranges row by row

choices.c2: Picture the whole pipeline and where this fits in it

questions.question: In a lecture on a new model architecture, you're most drawn to...

choices.c1: The exact formulas and implementation details

choices.c2: The bigger idea it borrows from and where else it could apply

questions.question: Your teammate's approach to the project is inefficient. You...

choices.c1: Point out the flaw directly so it gets fixed

choices.c2: Ease into it, framing it as a suggestion

questions.question: When picking a project topic for the team, you weigh...

choices.c1: Which idea is technically the most interesting

choices.c2: Which idea the whole team will enjoy working on

questions.question: Two weeks before a deadline, your notebook looks like....

choices.c1: A clear plan with milestones already checked off

choices.c2: A dozen open tabs and experiments in progress

questions.question: Your ideal way to explore a new dataset is to...

choices.c1: Follow a structured EDA checklist top to bottom

choices.c2: Poke around wherever looks interesting first
